essence: The fire mantra is declared to consist of ten syllables.
The mantra's seer is Dakṣa, its meter is Virāṭ, and its deity is Śrī.
The weapon mantra begins with praṇava and ends with namaḥ addressed to the lotus-formed deity.
After performing enclosure worship, the practitioner should proceed with the prescribed rite.
The practitioner should complete the rite up to incense offerings and dismissal.
